login.failed.en: That username and password did not match. Check both and try again.

login.sessionExpired.en: Your session expired. Sign in to continue.

login.handoffExpired.en: That sign-in link has already been used or has expired. Sign in with your username and password.

login.noReset.en: There is no password reset here. On a self-hosted workspace it is changed on the server; on a hosted one, support can help.

schedules.emptyPrompt.en: Set up a recurring task for me: what should run, and when.

schedules.deleteConfirm.en: Delete the scheduled task "{name}"? It stops firing immediately.

nav.visitChat.en: Work done when “{chat}” asked this project

settings.models.description.en: Which model the agent answers with. Choose a project to give it a model of its own.

settings.workspaceModel.description.en: The orchestrator answers with it, and so does every project without a model of its own.

settings.general.description.en: Theme, language and signing in to this dashboard.

settings.thinkingDescription.en: How much the model reasons before it answers. Saved together with the model.

settings.savedModelUnavailable.en: The saved model {model} is not on this provider's list any more, and nothing else can answer. Pick a model below.

settings.savedModelUnavailableAnswering.en: The saved model {model} is not on this provider's list any more, so {provider} · {runtime} is answering instead. Pick a model below.

settings.logoutConfirm.en: Disconnect {provider}? Its saved key or sign-in will be removed.

skills.projectRouting.intro.en: Each row is a separate project with its own files and memory. When a message belongs to one of them, switch to that project and work there; otherwise stay here.

settings.models.keySavedSwitched.en: Key saved. This workspace now answers on {model}.

settings.models.keySavedNoModel.en: Key saved, but {provider} did not offer a model to switch to, so this workspace still answers on the model it used before. Pick a model below once the provider lists one.

settings.models.keySavedStillOnIncluded.en: Key saved, but this workspace is still set to the included model and keeps spending its credits. Switch to your own model below to start using this key.

settings.fileHistory.description.en: Every change to a document or text file is kept as a version you can compare and restore.

settings.fileHistory.retention.en: Every version is kept for {keep} days after it is replaced, then one a day up to {daily} days.

settings.fileHistory.usage.en: History takes {size} of up to {cap} · versions: {versions} · files: {files}

settings.fileHistory.ceiling.en: It never grows past {cap}: the versions replaced longest ago go first, and when the disk is nearly full it shrinks to make room for the files themselves.

settings.fileHistory.usageFailed.en: Could not read how much space the history takes.

settings.fileHistory.countsToDisk.en: File history counts toward the workspace's disk space.

settings.fileHistory.clearOldConfirm.en: Delete every version replaced more than {days} days ago? The current text of every file stays.

settings.fileHistory.clearAllConfirm.en: Delete the whole history of every file? The files themselves stay as they are.

settings.fileHistory.unavailable.en: File history is turned off on this server.

settings.darkMode.description.en: Switch between light and dark theme.

settings.language.description.en: Choose the interface language for this Eggent workspace.

settings.errors.providerEnvJson.en: Provider env must be a JSON object, for example {"CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID":"..."}.

settings.logoutEggentAiConfirm.en: Switch from Eggent AI to your own provider? Images, voice and memory stop using Eggent AI too, and projects on its models follow your new model. Any of them can be turned back on under Advanced.

settings.modelLock.enforcedDescription.en: This workspace runs on {label} and the model cannot be changed here. Eggent is open source — run it yourself to use your own provider, API key or a local model.

settings.services.description.en: While this workspace runs on your own model, {label} does none of these. Turn it on for any one of them, or point images and voice at a provider of your own. Leaving {label} again turns it off for all of them.

settings.services.descriptionOwnOnly.en: Images and voice can use a provider of your own. Without one there are no images, and voice is transcribed on this server.

settings.services.noProviders.en: No provider with an API key yet

settings.services.noProvidersHint.en: Only a provider connected with an API key can do this. A subscription sign-in has no key to send.

settings.services.images.modelPlaceholde.en: Image model id from your provider

settings.services.images.managedUnavaila.en: {label} cannot draw for this workspace right now.

settings.services.images.providerUnusabl.en: {provider} cannot be used right now: connect it with an API key again, or choose another provider.

settings.services.speech.modelPlaceholde.en: Transcription model id from your provider

settings.services.speech.managedUnavaila.en: {label} cannot take recordings from this workspace right now, so Whisper on this server transcribes them.

settings.services.speech.providerUnusabl.en: {provider} cannot transcribe right now, so Whisper on this server does. Connect it with an API key, or choose another provider.

settings.services.learning.description.en: The short look back after a reply, where the agent keeps notes and skills.

settings.replaceKeyLabel.en: A key is already saved. Paste a new one to replace it.

settings.managedReturn.description.en: Your {label} access is still here. Switching back takes one click and does not need a key.

projectSub.settings.lockedChoiceNote.en: This workspace runs on {label}. A project can answer with a different {label} model - a cheaper one for bulk work, a stronger one where it pays off.

files.panel.discardChanges.en: This file has unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

files.updatedElsewhere.en: The file changed and has been reloaded.

files.changedWhileEditing.en: This file was changed while you were editing it - by the agent, a restore or the sync.

files.history.versionMissing.en: This version is not available any more.

files.history.off.en: File history is turned off for this workspace.

files.history.restoreWouldLose.en: The file as it is now cannot be kept in its history (it has grown too large to keep, or cannot be read), so restoring would lose it. Download it first if you need it.

files.history.restoreAnyway.en: The file as it is now cannot be kept in its history, so restoring will replace it for good. Restore anyway?

files.history.saveWouldLose.en: This file was changed while it was open and is now too large to keep in its history, so saving would lose that change. Reload it before saving.

files.history.loadFailed.en: Could not load the history of this file.

files.history.notVersioned.en: This kind of file has no history. It is kept for text files and documents, not for pictures, recordings, archives or PDFs.

files.history.empty.en: No history yet. Versions appear here as the file changes: when you save it, when the agent writes it, or when the sync brings a new copy.

files.history.noComparison.en: Versions of this kind of file cannot be compared here, but any of them can be downloaded or restored.

files.history.tooLarge.en: These versions differ too much to compare here. Download both to compare them.

files.history.firstVersion.en: This is the first version kept: there is nothing before it to compare with.

files.history.sameTextDocument.en: The text is the same. What changed is the formatting or something else inside the document.

files.history.extractedNote.en: Compared by the text inside the document; formatting is not compared.

files.history.restoreConfirm.en: Bring back version {n}? What the file holds now stays in the history, so this can be undone.

files.history.restored.en: Version {n} is back. The text it replaced is kept in the history.

files.history.restoredLost.en: Version {n} is back. What it replaced could not be kept in the history.

files.history.isCurrent.en: This is what the file holds now.

files.history.nowTooLarge.en: The file has since grown too large to keep in its history, so what it holds now is not here. Restoring a version replaces it for good.

files.history.nowUnreadable.en: What the file holds now cannot be read, so it is not in its history. Restoring a version replaces it for good.

files.history.forgetConfirm.en: Delete every saved version of this file? The file itself stays as it is.

files.page.selectHelp.en: Pick a block on the page: the agent sees it. Double-click a block to change its words.

files.page.selectHint.en: Click a block to pick it; double-click to change its words, Enter to save.

files.page.saveFirst.en: Save the code first: the page shows the saved file.

files.page.unsavedNotShown.en: Unsaved changes in the code are not on the page yet.

files.page.loadFailed.en: The page could not be shown.

files.page.changedReloaded.en: The file changed, so the page was shown again.

files.page.onlyText.en: Only words can be changed on the page. For anything else, ask the agent or change the code.

files.page.noText.en: There are no words to change in this block.

files.page.cannotEdit.en: This part of the page cannot be changed here. Ask the agent or change the code.

files.page.notWritten.en: Not saved: the page was shown again, try once more.

files.history.by.earlier.en: As it was before the first change

chat.modelPicker.saveFailed.en: The model could not be changed.

chat.modelPicker.scopeProject.en: Applies to this project. Change it any time in Settings.

chat.modelPicker.scopeWorkspace.en: Applies to the whole workspace, and to every project without its own model.

settings.modelLock.chooseModelHint.en: Every model here is covered by the same balance. A cheaper one makes it last longer.

settings.errors.returnToManaged.en: Failed to switch back to the included model

settings.providerDisconnectedDescription.en: After this provider is connected, its available models will appear here.

settings.noLoginMethod.en: This provider does not expose a login method here.

settings.customProvidersDescription.en: Add a custom provider here, save models.json, and it will appear in the provider list above.

settings.managedRepaired.en: The included model was missing from models.json and has been added back. Providers you added yourself were left as they were.

settings.managedRepairedFromBroken.en: models.json could not be read, so it was kept as {path} and written again with the included model.

chat.contextMode.trigger.en: How much context this chat carries

chat.contextMode.hint.en: How much of the workspace goes into every message. The full mode sends every tool, skill and workspace instruction — about 12 000 tokens before you have typed anything. Chosen when a chat starts and kept for its whole life.

chat.contextMode.locked.en: The mode is chosen when a chat starts and does not change. Open a new chat for a different one.

chat.contextMode.fullDescription.en: Everything: files, web, images, Telegram, schedules, skills and the workspace instructions. ~12 000 tokens per message.

chat.contextMode.plainDescription.en: Your question and this chat's history, nothing else. No tools at all. ~250 tokens per message.

chat.contextMode.filesDescription.en: Plus reading files and switching between projects. No writing, commands or web. ~700 tokens per message.

chat.attachFilesDisabled.en: Send a message first to attach files

chat.steer.queued.en: Waiting: the agent reads it after the step it is on

chat.steer.afterTurn.en: Goes out when the agent finishes

chat.steer.undelivered.en: The agent did not get to this: the turn ended first.

chat.steer.command.en: A command can be sent once the agent has finished.

chat.steer.failed.en: The message could not be added to the turn. It is back in the field.

chat.placeholder.en: Send a message or paste an image...

chat.waitingToolPlaceholder.en: Send input to the waiting tool…

chat.commandHelp.en: ↑/↓ select · Enter/Tab insert · then send normally

chat.recording.en: Recording… press the microphone again to transcribe.

chat.voiceHttpsRequired.en: Voice input requires HTTPS. Open Eggent via a secure domain or use localhost; browsers block microphone access on public HTTP addresses.

chat.voiceUnsupportedBrowser.en: Voice input is not supported by this browser.

chat.audioUnsupportedBrowser.en: Audio recording is not supported by this browser.

chat.microphoneBlocked.en: Microphone access was blocked. Allow microphone permissions and make sure Eggent is opened over HTTPS.

chat.microphoneMissing.en: No microphone was found on this device.

chat.microphoneBusy.en: The microphone is already in use by another app or cannot be read.

chat.waitForUpload.en: Wait until the file has uploaded

chat.emptyDescription.en: Write in the box below — a question, a file, a link. Or take one of the ready paths: Eggent asks what it needs and sets it up itself.

chat.emptyDescriptionPlain.en: Write in the box below — a question, a task, a file, a link.

chat.projects.mentionHelp.en: Tab or Enter to choose. The project does the task in a chat of its own and the answer comes back here.

chat.projects.willAsk.en: Will ask the project “{project}” and bring the answer back here.

chat.openFile.sees.en: The agent sees the open file {name}

chat.openFile.stop.en: Do not tell the agent about this file

composer.secret.botToken.en: A Telegram bot token. What you send here stays in this chat's history; connect the bot in Settings instead.

composer.secret.apiKey.en: A key for a model provider. What you send here stays in this chat's history; add it in Settings instead.

composer.secret.generic.en: A password, key or token. What you send here stays in this chat's history. Send it only if the agent has to use it right now.

chat.helpers.now.helper.en: Starting a helper of its own…

chat.helpers.detachedNote.en: This helper ran detached, and its result never came back to this chat.

chat.usage.hint.en: Tokens this whole chat has spent, across every answer.

settings.usage.project.en: This project has spent {count} tokens across {chats} chats.

settings.softLimit.label.en: Warn past this many tokens per chat

settings.softLimit.description.en: Zero turns the warning off. It only colours the chat's total and never stops a turn.

chat.usage.overSoftLimit.en: This chat has passed the soft limit: {limit} tokens.

chat.quickStartHint.en: Pick one — Eggent walks you through it

chat.thinkingLong.en: On a big task the model can think for several minutes before its first word. It is still working: the answer will appear here.

chat.errors.stoppedEarly.en: The model stopped before producing a final response.

chat.errors.emptyResponse.en: The model returned an empty response (0 tokens). The provider may be rate-limiting or out of quota, or the API key may be wrong — check the key in Settings.

chat.errors.noModelSelected.en: No model is selected for this workspace. Open Settings, pick a provider you have connected, and choose its model.

chat.errors.providerNoCredential.en: {provider} is the default provider, but this workspace has no credential for it, so nothing can run. Open Settings and connect {provider} — check that the API key is correct — or switch to a provider that is already connected.

chat.errors.providerUnreachable.en: {provider} did not respond at all, so nothing can run. Check the provider's address in Settings → Models and login, and that the service is up.

chat.errors.providerLocalOnly.en: {provider} points at an address that only exists on the machine Eggent runs on, so a model running on your own computer cannot be reached from here. Use a provider available over the internet.

external.run.stopped.en: Stopped. Whatever was finished is saved — tell me what to do instead.

external.run.steered.en: Got it, I am taking that into account in what I am doing right now.

external.run.commandWhileRunning.en: That is a command: I can run it once I have finished what I am doing now. Send it again then.

external.run.reset.en: Stopped it. Your messages and what was finished are saved - write again to carry on, or send /new for a fresh start.

external.run.resetQuestion.en: Stopped it and dropped the question it was waiting on. Your messages and what was finished are saved - write again to carry on, or send /new for a fresh start.

external.run.resetIdle.en: Nothing is running here right now. Send /new if you want a fresh conversation.

external.run.resetFreed.en: It did not stop by itself, so I let go of it: you can write again. Whatever it was doing may finish quietly on its own.

external.files.none.en: There are no files from the last answer. Ask for something to be made, and then send /files.

external.files.hint.en: Files from this answer: {names}. Send /files to get them here.

external.files.sentArchivePart.en: Sent {count} of {total} files as one archive. The rest are in the Files panel.

external.files.tooLarge.en: These files are too large for Telegram. Open the Files panel in the browser to download them.

external.files.gone.en: Those files are no longer there.

external.run.stalled.en: I stopped this: nothing had happened for {minutes} min, and a model that has gone quiet this long is not coming back. Your messages are saved - write again to carry on, or send /new for a fresh start.

external.run.stalledStart.en: I stopped this: the workspace had not finished getting ready after {minutes} min. Your messages are saved - write again to try once more.

external.run.stalledTool.en: I stopped this: a command had been running for {minutes} min without a word. Whatever it finished is saved - write again to carry on, ideally in smaller steps.

external.run.stalledQuestion.en: I stopped here: the question above waited {hours} h without an answer. Answer it in this chat whenever you are ready, and I will carry on from there.

external.run.stalledQuestionMinutes.en: I stopped here: the question above waited {minutes} min without an answer. Answer it in this chat whenever you are ready, and I will carry on from there.

chat.compaction.runningAuto.en: Compacting the context so the conversation can continue…

chat.compaction.done.en: Context compacted: {before} tokens before, about {after} after.

chat.errors.providerRejectedKey.en: {provider} rejected the API key, so nothing can run. Open Settings → Models and login and paste a valid key.

chat.errors.providerModelMissing.en: {provider} answered, but does not offer the model "{model}", so every request comes back empty. It offers: {models}. Pick one of those in Settings → Models and login.

chat.errors.turnFailed.en: The model stopped with an error before it finished. What was done above is saved - send the message again to carry on.

chat.errors.returnToIncluded.en: You can also go back to the included Eggent AI model in Settings → Models and login and keep working straight away.

chat.errors.emptyFinal.en: The model stopped before producing a final response. Please retry.

chat.errors.noFinalAfterTools.en: Tools completed, but the final answer was not produced. Send `continue`, and I will finish the response.

projects.description.en: Manage project workspaces and run onboarding for first setup.

projects.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this project? This cannot be undone.

onboarding.description.en: Eggent starts with a default admin login. Replace it now — then you pick a model and you are done.

projects.instructionsPlaceholder.en: Special instructions for the AI when working on this project...

projects.noProjectsDescription.en: You can work in Orchestrator or create a dedicated project when needed.

projects.errors.reservedName.en: Project name "{name}" is reserved for the orchestrator.

projects.errors.passwordMin.en: Password must be at least 8 characters.

files.produced.sendFailed.en: Telegram did not take the file.

files.produced.skippedSecrets.en: Left out of the archive: {count} with secrets in them.

files.uploadReplacePrompt.en: {count} file(s) already exist here. Replace them?

context.description.en: Instructions the agent gets in every chat. The orchestrator and each project have their own.

memory.description.en: Notes the agent keeps between chats: it searches, adds to and deletes from them itself. The orchestrator and each project have their own.

learning.settings.description.en: After a conversation the agent may keep a short note about you or the work, or write a skill for a task it will meet again. These are read at the start of every chat, and you can change or remove anything here.

learning.settings.enabledHint.en: When off, nothing new is saved. What is already here keeps being used.

learning.settings.unavailable.en: Learning is switched off for this workspace by whoever runs it.

learning.settings.addFailed.en: That note could not be saved: {reason}

learning.settings.loadFailed.en: Could not load what the agent has learned.

learning.settings.skillsHint.en: They live in the skills folder. A skill that goes unused for a long time is marked, and later moved to skills/.archive. Nothing is ever deleted.

learning.reason.secret.en: it looks like a password, key or token, and those are never saved

learning.reason.override.en: it tries to override the assistant's instructions

learning.reason.role.en: it is worded as an instruction rather than as a fact

learning.reason.too_long.en: it is too long - one short sentence is enough

learning.reason.heading.en: it cannot start with a heading mark

learning.reason.credential_url.en: it contains a web address with a login and password

learning.reason.url_send.en: it combines a web address with an instruction to send something

learning.reason.similar.en: a very similar note is already saved

learning.reason.full.en: that list is full - remove a note first

learning.reason.too_many_entries.en: that list already holds as many notes as it can

google.card.titleWithCalendar.en: Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Calendar

google.card.explain.en: Connect your Google account and the agent can make documents, spreadsheets and presentations in your Drive. It opens only the files it made and the ones you pick - never your other files. Changing a file you picked, or sharing one by link, waits for your yes; it never deletes anything.

google.card.explainWithCalendar.en: Connect your Google account and the agent can make documents, spreadsheets and presentations in your Drive and add events to a calendar called Eggent. It opens only the files it made and the ones you pick - never your other files. Changing a file you picked, or sharing one by link, waits for your yes; it never deletes anything.

google.card.pickedNow.en: Files chosen: {count}. Tell the agent to carry on.

google.card.connectedNowChat.en: Google is connected. Tell the agent to carry on.

google.card.returnFailed.en: Connecting Google did not finish. Try again from this page.

google.card.calendarConsent.en: Adding events needs one more permission: connect again and allow the calendar.

google.card.disconnectConfirm.en: Disconnect {email}? The agent will no longer reach your Google files; the files stay in your Drive.

google.card.failed.en: Could not change the Google connection. Try again in a minute.

messengers.description.en: Connect external messengers to the agent. Telegram is available now.

messengers.availableCommands.en: Available commands in Telegram private chat:

messengers.command.code.en: activate access for your Telegram user_id

messengers.command.new.en: start a new conversation and reset context

messengers.command.reset.en: stop a stuck answer, keep the conversation

messengers.command.files.en: send the files the last answer made

messengers.notes.en: Notes: only private chats are supported. Uploaded files are saved into chat files, and you can ask the agent to send a local file back to Telegram.

externalApiToken.description.en: Create a token for {header} and rotate it when needed.

externalApiToken.envDetected.en: Env token detected. Generate to create and use an app-managed token.

apiDocs.description.en: Send messages to Eggent from your app, workflow, bot, or webhook. Eggent keeps session state by sessionId, so follow-up calls can continue the same project/chat context.

apiDocs.requiredFields.en: Required body fields: sessionId and message.

apiDocs.field.sessionId.en: Stable external user/thread id. Used to remember context.

apiDocs.field.message.en: Text to send to the Eggent agent.

apiDocs.field.projectId.en: Pin or switch this external session to a project by id. Also accepts an exact unique project name.

apiDocs.field.projectName.en: Pin or switch by exact project name when you do not know the id.

apiDocs.field.chatId.en: Reuse a specific Eggent chat instead of auto-created session chat.

apiDocs.field.currentPath.en: Optional relative path hint inside the selected project.

apiDocs.omittedProjectNote.en: If projectId / projectName is omitted, Eggent uses the session's last active project. If there is no active project and multiple projects exist, the API returns 409 with available projects.

projectContext.noMcp.en: No `.mcp.json` found for this project. Save to create it.

projectContext.noSkillsDescription.en: Project skills will appear here after installation.

knowledge.noFilesTitle.en: No files in knowledge base yet.

knowledge.noFilesDescription.en: Upload PDF, Word, text, or images to give the agent context.

knowledge.noChatMemory.en: No chat memory saved for this project yet.

knowledge.confirmDeleteFile.en: Are you sure you want to delete "{filename}"?

knowledge.confirmDeleteMemory.en: Are you sure you want to delete this memory?

modelWizard.optionalToken.en: Optional token (leave empty for local servers)

modelWizard.envHint.en: Or set {envKey} as an environment variable

modelWizard.noApiKeyRequiredMode.en: API key input is not required for this connection mode.

modelWizard.cliTokens.en: OAuth tokens are read from local CLI auth files.

modelWizard.ollamaNoKey.en: API Key not required — connecting to local Ollama

modelWizard.customNoKey.en: API Key optional — works for local OpenAI-compatible servers (LM Studio, etc.)

modelWizard.dimensionsHint.en: Dimensions are auto-detected for known models. Adjust if necessary.

mcp.description.en: View and edit the MCP servers configured in {file} for the orchestrator or for a project, and switch between them. Runtime access is provided by Eggent.

mcp.noServersDescription.en: Servers configured in .mcp.json will appear here.

mcp.createHint.en: `.mcp.json` does not exist yet for this project. Save to create it.

schedules.description.en: View scheduled work managed by Eggent.

schedules.hint.en: Create or change schedules from chat. Eggent uses the Agent tool with a schedule value.

schedules.emptyDescription.en: Schedules will appear here after they are created from an Eggent chat/session.

skills.description.en: Browse the skills installed in the orchestrator or in a project, and install bundled skills into the selected workspace. Installed skills live in its {path} directory.

skills.noInstalledDescription.en: Skills installed in this workspace will appear here.

skills.catalogDescription.en: Install prebuilt skills into the selected workspace. Skills are copied to its {path} directory.

skills.noBundledDescription.en: Try a different search or select another project.

skills.deleteConfirm.en: Delete the skill “{name}”? Its folder and everything in it will be removed, along with any earlier versions kept when it was replaced. This cannot be undone.

skills.delete.error.notFound.en: There is no skill named “{skill}” in this workspace.

skills.delete.error.failed.en: The skill could not be deleted.

skills.upload.description.en: Add a skill you already have as a file to the selected workspace. It is checked first, and nothing is saved unless the check passes.

skills.upload.drop.en: Drag and drop skill files here, or browse — you can add several at once

skills.upload.hintMarkdown.en: .md file: a SKILL.md that starts with a YAML header holding the skill's name and description

skills.upload.hintArchive.en: .zip or .skill file: an archive with a SKILL.md at the top or inside one folder — scripts/, references/, assets/ and other folders can come with it

skills.upload.checksNote.en: The structure is checked: the SKILL.md header, file names, links and size. What a script does is not, so upload only skills you trust — the agent can run them.

skills.upload.replaced.en: Replaced “{skill}”. The previous version is kept in {kept}.

skills.upload.note.learnedMarkerRemoved.en: The line origin: learned was removed from the header: the skill is yours now, and the agent will not change it.

skills.upload.note.emptyBody.en: SKILL.md has a header but no instructions under it.

skills.upload.error.network.en: Could not reach the server. Nothing was installed.

skills.upload.error.notAllowed.en: You are signed out, or the session expired. Reload the page and try again.

skills.upload.error.badRequest.en: The upload could not be read. Try again.

skills.upload.error.projectNotFound.en: That project does not exist any more.

skills.upload.error.unsupportedType.en: “{name}” is not a skill file. Upload a .md file, or a .zip or .skill archive.

skills.upload.error.tooLarge.en: {size} is too big for a skill — at most {limit}.

skills.upload.error.notZip.en: This is not a readable ZIP archive. It may be damaged or cut off; create it again.

skills.upload.error.zipUnsupported.en: The archive uses something that is not supported ({detail}). Create it again with a standard zip tool.

skills.upload.error.zipEncrypted.en: The archive is password-protected. Upload one without a password.

skills.upload.error.zipCorrupt.en: “{path}” is damaged inside the archive. Create the archive again.

skills.upload.error.tooManyFiles.en: The skill holds {count} files and folders; at most {limit} are allowed.

skills.upload.error.unpackedTooLarge.en: The files add up to {size} unpacked; at most {limit} are allowed.

skills.upload.error.unsafePath.en: “{path}” has a file name that is not allowed: it climbs out of the skill's folder, has control characters, or is too long.

skills.upload.error.link.en: “{path}” is a link or a special file, which a skill may not contain.

skills.upload.error.duplicatePath.en: “{path}” appears more than once in the archive.

skills.upload.error.skillMdMissing.en: SKILL.md was not found in the archive. Put it at the top of the archive, or directly inside the one folder that holds the skill.

skills.upload.error.skillMdCase.en: Found “{path}”, but the file has to be named SKILL.md, in capital letters.

skills.upload.error.skillMdNested.en: SKILL.md is only at “{path}”, which is too deep. It has to be at the top of the archive, or directly inside its single top folder.

skills.upload.error.severalSkills.en: The archive holds several skills ({names}). Upload them one at a time.

skills.upload.error.skillMdNotText.en: SKILL.md is not a UTF-8 text file.

skills.upload.error.skillMdTooLarge.en: SKILL.md is {size}; at most {limit} is allowed. Move detail into files under references/.

skills.upload.error.frontmatterMissing.en: SKILL.md has no header. It has to start with a --- line, then the name and description as YAML, then a second --- line.

skills.upload.error.frontmatterUnclosed.en: The header at the top of SKILL.md is never closed: add a second --- line after it.

skills.upload.error.frontmatterYaml.en: The header of SKILL.md is not valid YAML (line {line}): {reason}. If a value contains a colon followed by a space, put the whole value in quotes.

skills.upload.error.frontmatterNotMap.en: The header of SKILL.md has to be lines of “key: value”.

skills.upload.error.fieldMissing.en: The header of SKILL.md has no “{field}”.

skills.upload.error.fieldNotText.en: “{field}” in the header of SKILL.md has to be text.

skills.upload.error.fieldTooLong.en: “{field}” in the header of SKILL.md is {length} characters; at most {limit} are allowed.

skills.upload.error.nameInvalid.en: The skill name “{name}” is not allowed. Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, none at either end — for example pdf-parsing.

skills.upload.error.learnedMarker.en: The header says origin: learned, which is reserved for skills the agent writes. Remove that line and upload again.

skills.upload.error.exists.en: A skill named “{skill}” is already installed in this workspace.

skills.upload.error.writeFailed.en: The skill could not be saved. Nothing was installed.

projectDetail.description.en: This project is a directory. Its context, memory, skills, MCP, and model settings are stored as files in the project folder and used by Eggent when the agent runs. Scheduled tasks are managed by Eggent.

projectDetail.file.context.description.en: Primary instructions injected into the project agent.

projectDetail.file.memory.description.en: Plain Markdown memory used by Eggent bridge tools.

projectDetail.file.skills.description.en: Project-local skills, each with a SKILL.md file.

projectDetail.file.mcp.description.en: Project-only MCP servers available to the agent.

projectDetail.file.model.description.en: The workspace model, or one of its own for this project.

projectSub.settings.workspaceFollows.en: When the workspace model changes, this project changes with it.

projectSub.settings.workspaceNone.en: The workspace has no model selected yet. Choose one for the workspace first.

projectSub.settings.projectDescription.en: Any model from the providers connected to the workspace. Other projects keep theirs.

projectSub.settings.noProviders.en: No provider is connected yet. Connect one for the workspace, then come back to choose its model.

projectSub.settings.unavailable.en: The model saved for this project isn't available right now, so it is answering with the workspace model. Reconnect the provider for the workspace or choose another model.

projectSub.settings.lockedDescription.en: While the workspace runs on {label}, projects can't have a model of their own. Connect your own provider for the workspace, and each project can then use it, another connected provider, or {label}.

projectSub.settings.unreadable.en: model.json isn't valid JSON, so the form starts from the workspace model. Fix the file under Advanced, or save a choice here to replace it.

projectSub.settings.loadFailed.en: Couldn't load this project's model settings.

projectSub.settings.editorDescription.en: The file this form writes. "inheritsGlobal": true follows the workspace; false together with "provider" and "model" gives the project its own.

orchestrator.description.en: The agent that answers when no project is selected. It keeps the same four files as a project — context, memory, skills and MCP — in its own working directory.

api.error.projectIdAndFilePathRequired.en: Project ID and file path required

api.error.zipEmpty.en: There is nothing to put in an archive here.

api.error.zipTooLarge.en: This is too large to download as one archive ({size}; the limit is {limit}). Download parts of it, or sync the folder to your computer.

api.error.zipTooMany.en: This holds too many files for one archive ({count}; the limit is {limit}). Download parts of it.

api.error.zipTooDeep.en: These folders are nested too deeply for one archive.

api.error.zipBusy.en: Another archive is being prepared. Try again in a moment.

api.error.telegramFileTooLarge.en: This file is too large to send through Telegram.

telegram.bot.progress.long.en: 🧠 Still working — not stuck, just a long task.

telegram.bot.draft.helpers.en: Helpers at work: {running} of {total} still going…

telegram.bot.draft.silent.en: Still working… it has been quiet for a while. Send /reset if you want to stop it.

telegram.bot.help.chats.en: /chats - recent chats; tap one to continue it

telegram.bot.help.reset.en: /reset - stop an answer that seems stuck (the conversation is kept)

telegram.bot.help.filesCommand.en: /files - send the files the last answer made

telegram.bot.help.text.en: Text messages are sent to the agent.

telegram.bot.help.mention.en: Start a message with @ and a project's name to hand it a task; its answer comes back here.

telegram.bot.help.voice.en: Voice messages are transcribed locally and sent to the agent.

telegram.bot.help.files.en: File uploads are saved into chat files.

telegram.bot.help.sendBack.en: You can also ask the agent to send a local file back to Telegram.

telegram.bot.accessGranted.en: Access granted. You can now send messages to the agent.

telegram.bot.greeting.en: Hi! Eggent is connected to this bot ✅

telegram.bot.needAccess.en: To start chatting with the agent, activate access with a code from Telegram settings.

telegram.bot.newChat.en: Started a new conversation. Context is cleared for the next message.

telegram.bot.leftProject.en: Left the project. You are back in the orchestrator.

telegram.bot.unsupported.en: Only text messages, voice messages, and file uploads are supported right now.

telegram.command.here.en: Run this chat on this side

telegram.chats.hint.en: Tap a chat's /c_ command to continue it. /new starts a new one.

telegram.chats.notFound.en: No chat matches that. /chats lists the recent ones.

telegram.chats.opened.en: Now in “{title}”. Your next message continues this chat.

schedules.run.failed.en: Scheduled task "{job}" did not finish this time. It will try again at its next time.

schedules.paused.refused.en: Scheduled task "{job}" is paused: its last {count} runs were turned away before they could start.

schedules.paused.failed.en: Scheduled task "{job}" is paused: its last {count} runs ended with an error.

schedules.paused.resume.en: Once that is dealt with, resume it in Settings → Schedules, or ask me to resume it.

terminal.run.runHint.en: Run this in the project folder, where the agent works

terminal.run.timeout.en: Stopped: it ran past the time limit

terminal.run.lost.en: Cut off before it finished (the workspace may have restarted)

terminal.run.earlierDropped.en: The start of the output is not kept

terminal.run.inputPlaceholder.en: Answer the command, then press Enter

terminal.run.askTruncated.en: (only the end of the output is included)

terminal.shellMode.hint.en: Shell command: runs in the project folder, not sent to the agent

terminal.shellMode.escape.en: To send a message that really begins with !, start it with !!

terminal.panel.unavailable.en: An interactive terminal needs Python 3 on this computer. Commands still run from the chat: press Run under a code block, or start a message with !.

terminal.panel.closed.idle.en: Closed because it had not been used for a while, so it does not stay open in the background.

terminal.panel.closed.detached.en: Closed because nothing had been watching it for a while.

terminal.panel.closed.shutdown.en: The workspace restarted, which ended the terminal.

terminal.panel.closed.timeout.en: The terminal ran out of time.

browser.panel.notOpen.en: The agent's browser is not open. The agent opens it when a task needs one; you can open it yourself to sign in somewhere first.

browser.panel.youHaveControl.en: You have control: open a page from the address bar, click, scroll and type on the picture. The agent waits until you hand it back.

browser.panel.agentHasControl.en: The agent is using the browser. Take control to sign in or to do a step yourself.

browser.panel.forgetConfirm.en: Close the browser and forget every site it is signed in to?

browser.panel.forgotten.en: The browser is closed and its sign-ins are forgotten.

browser.panel.error.en: The browser could not be reached: {reason}

browser.panel.picture.en: The page in the agent's browser

browser.panel.typing.en: Type here to type on the page

browser.panel.addressPlaceholder.en: Type an address and press Enter

browser.panel.notAnAddress.en: That is not a page address. Type one like example.com.

cloudPromo.lead.en: The same Eggent, hosted for you. Updates and security are on us.

cloudPromo.keysText.en: Eggent AI gives you the most popular models and image generation.

cloudPromo.awayText.en: Schedules and the Telegram bot keep going when your computer is off.

cloudPromo.anywhereText.en: Your own address with HTTPS, on your phone or any computer.

cloudPromo.browser.en: A cloud browser your agent drives

cloudPromo.pages.en: Reads pages a plain request cannot open

cloudPromo.skills.en: Ready-made skills: documents, a morning digest and more

cloudPromo.telegram.en: Telegram in one tap, no bot to set up

cloudPromo.sync.en: Files in sync between your computer and the cloud

cloudPromo.team.en: For a team: colleagues' workspaces, shared folders, approvals

remote.error.offlineCloud.en: The cloud workspace can't be reached right now. Check the connection, or run this chat on this computer instead.

remote.error.offlineDevice.en: {where} isn't available right now: the Eggent app is closed, offline, or not set to take tasks from the cloud. Run this chat in the cloud instead, or open the app and try again.

remote.error.notReady.en: {where} can't take this chat yet: its chat history isn't shared with the cloud.

remote.error.engine.en: {where} can't run this chat right now. {reason} Sort it out in the app on that computer, or run this chat here instead.

remote.error.notSynced.en: {where} hasn't received this chat's latest changes yet. Give it a few seconds and send again.

remote.error.busy.en: This chat is working right now. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.

remote.error.notSyncedMove.en: The chat can't be moved yet: this side hasn't received everything the other side wrote in it. Give it a few seconds and try again.

remote.error.moved.en: This chat was moved to this side a moment ago, before this screen had heard of it. Give it a few seconds and send again.

remote.error.disabled.en: Running chats on another side isn't set up here.

remote.error.failed.en: The message couldn't be handed to {where}: {reason}

remote.error.lost.en: The connection to {where} was lost. The turn may still be running there; its answer will appear in this chat when it syncs.

remote.error.hintHere.en: Send /here to run this chat on this side instead.

external.here.done.en: Done. This chat runs here now.

external.here.unavailable.en: Running a chat on another side isn't set up here.

external.here.busy.en: This chat is working right now, so it cannot be moved. Wait for it to finish, or send "stop" (or /reset) first.

external.here.notSynced.en: This chat hasn't fully arrived here yet. Give it a few seconds and send /here again.

chat.runPlace.hint.en: Where this chat runs. Messages go there whichever side you type them on, and the answer comes back here.

chat.runPlace.unavailableReason.en: The app is closed, offline, or not set to take tasks from the cloud.

chat.runPlace.notReadyReason.en: Its chat history isn't shared with the cloud yet.

chat.runPlace.cloudUnreachable.en: The cloud can't be reached right now.

chat.runPlace.busy.en: Wait for the current turn to finish first.

chat.runPlace.modelOnDeviceHint.en: This chat runs on {place}: it answers with the model or program chosen there, in the Eggent app.

chat.runPlace.modelInCloudHint.en: This chat runs in the cloud: it answers with the model chosen there.

board.description.en: Work you hand to the agent as cards. Each card is carried out in a conversation of its own, one after another, and the board tells you when one needs you.

board.limits.en: Up to {running} cards work at once, {perProject} per project: cards of one project share its folder.

board.column.inboxHint.en: Not started. Cards the agent proposes wait here for you.

board.column.queuedHint.en: Starts by itself when there is room, top first.

board.column.waitingHint.en: Stopped for you: a question, a failure, a check.

board.column.doneHint.en: Finished. The last answer is the result.

board.paused.body.en: The model service refused a card's run, so nothing else starts until you resume - otherwise every card in the queue would be refused in turn.

board.empty.body.en: Write a card here, or ask the agent in any chat to plan a job as tasks: it puts them in the Inbox for you to start.

board.form.bodyPlaceholder.en: What to do, with everything needed to do it without you: sources, what the result should look like, where to save it.

board.form.afterNone.en: Nothing: as soon as there is room

board.form.afterHint.en: It starts only once every card ticked here is done, and gets their results.

board.form.review.en: Let me check the result before it counts as done

board.form.placeCloud.en: In the cloud. It keeps going while your computer is off.

board.form.placeDevice.en: On {name}, with the files and programs there. That computer is asked first, as for a chat handed to it, and the card waits in the queue while the computer is away.

board.form.placeHere.en: On this computer, with its files and programs. The cloud starts it here, so the card waits in the queue while the app is closed.

board.form.placeHereOff.en: This computer does not take tasks from the cloud yet. Allow them in Eggent → Cloud & Sync → Tasks from your cloud; until then the card waits in the queue.

board.sheet.resultTruncated.en: The whole answer is in the conversation.

board.action.deleteConfirm.en: Delete the card “{title}” and its conversation? The files it made stay where they are.

board.chatBanner.en: This conversation is a card on the board.

board.error.tooManyAfter.en: A card can wait for at most {max} others.

board.error.afterSelf.en: A card cannot wait for itself.

board.error.noCard.en: That card is not on the board any more.

board.error.cycle.en: These cards would wait for each other, and none of them could ever start.

board.error.nothing.en: Nothing to put on the board.

board.error.tooMany.en: At most 30 cards at a time.

board.error.emptyCard.en: A card needs a title or a task.

board.error.running.en: The card is being worked on. Stop it first, or wait for it to finish.

board.error.agentStarted.en: The agent can change a card only while it waits in the Inbox.

board.error.projectFixed.en: The card has already run in its project, and its conversation is there.

board.error.moveRunning.en: A card starts by being put in the queue.

board.error.archiveActive.en: Only a card that is not working or waiting to start can be put away.

board.error.moveWaiting.en: A card waits for you when its run says so.

board.error.badHome.en: A card cannot be put to run there from this side.

board.error.stopUnreachable.en: The other side cannot be reached to stop it right now. Try again in a moment.

board.error.agentRemove.en: The agent can remove only a card it proposed that is still in the Inbox.

board.next.retry.en: The previous attempt stopped with an error: {error}. Carry on with the task from where it stopped.

board.next.resume.en: The previous run was cut off when the workspace restarted. Carry on with the task from where it stopped: check what is already done before doing anything again.

board.next.continue.en: Carry on with the task from where it stopped.

board.next.decide.en: Carry on without an answer to your question: decide it yourself and say what you chose.

board.next.redo.en: Do this task again, from the start.

board.message.parents.en: What the cards this one waited for came to:

mail.description.en: Write to the people of your company. Each person is one conversation. What they send arrives here, and in Telegram when it is linked.

mail.noContacts.en: There is nobody to write to yet.

mail.unavailable.en: Messages are not available in this workspace.

mail.empty.en: No messages yet. Write the first one below.

mail.composer.hint.en: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.

mail.message.assignHelp.en: Opens a chat with your agent about this message. Nothing is sent until you send it.

mail.file.copying.en: Being copied to your Messages folder

mail.banner.howItWorks.en: Tell the agent what to do with it. Under each answer there is a button to send it to {name}.

mail.sendTo.preview.en: This goes to {name}, signed as written by the agent for you. You can change it first.

mail.sendTo.files.en: With the files of this answer

mail.sendTo.empty.en: There is nothing to send: write the message first.

engines.error.notInstalled.en: {engine} is not installed on this computer, so this project cannot run on it. Install it, or pick another model in Settings → Models.

engines.error.signedOut.en: {engine} is not signed in on this computer. Open Settings → Models, press Sign in, then send your message again.

engines.error.limit.en: {engine} has reached the limit of your subscription{until}. Wait for it to open again, or pick another model for this project.

engines.error.unsupportedModel.en: {engine} does not accept that model on your account. Pick another one for this project in Settings → Models.

engines.error.apiKey.en: {engine} found an API key and would bill it instead of your subscription, so it was not started. Remove the key from its settings or from the environment, then send again.

engines.reason.apiKey.en: {engine} is set up with an API key, not a subscription.

engines.reason.limit.en: {engine} has reached its subscription limit for now.

engines.plate.hint.en: Programs found here that can do this project's work on your own subscription, with their own tools.

engines.plate.using.en: This project runs on {engine}. The model chosen for it below is not used while this is on.

engines.plate.usingHere.en: Chats outside projects run on {engine}. The workspace model is not used for them while this is on.

engines.plate.saveFailed.en: Could not save that. Try again.

engines.plate.hintHere.en: Programs found here that can do the work of chats outside any project on your own subscription, with their own tools.

engines.row.signingIn.en: Finish signing in in the browser…

engines.row.signInFailed.en: Signing in did not finish. Try again.

engines.row.problem.apiKey.en: It is set up with an API key, not a subscription: use would be billed to the key.

engines.row.problem.oldVersion.en: This version is too old. Update it first.

engines.row.problem.limit.en: The subscription limit is used up for now.

engines.access.projectHere.en: Changes only in your projects folder

engines.access.projectNoteHere.en: Files are changed only inside the folder that holds your projects, and what is read is sent to the company behind {engine}.

engines.access.projectNote.en: Files are changed only inside this project's folder, and what is read is sent to the company behind {engine}.

engines.access.fullNote.en: {engine} can read and change anything on this computer that you can, and runs commands without asking first.

engines.access.project.en: Changes only in this project's folder

engines.access.full.en: As in a terminal (the whole computer)

engines.consent.folder.en: {engine} works in the folder with its own tools, not with Eggent's.

engines.consent.cost.en: It uses the limits of your own subscription. Nothing is taken from your Eggent balance.

engines.consent.data.en: What you write and the files it reads go to the company behind {engine}.

engines.consent.missing.en: Schedules, question cards, Eggent skills and Telegram do not work in this mode, and Eggent learns nothing from these chats. It suits work with files and code.

engines.consent.experimental.en: {engine} is offered here as an experiment: it may change or stop working without notice.

engines.consent.saveFailed.en: Could not save the choice. Try again.

engines.chatNotice.en: {engine} does this chat's work with its own tools. Schedules, question cards, Eggent skills and Telegram are not available in this mode.

approvals.description.en: Versions of files your colleagues ask you to approve, and the ones you sent. What is approved is one version: any change to the file afterwards voids the approvals, and the new version starts the chain over.

approvals.unavailable.en: Approvals are not available in this workspace.

approvals.empty.sent.en: You have not sent anything for approval yet. Open a file and choose Approval.

approvals.empty.involved.en: Nobody has asked you to approve anything yet.

approvals.line.waitingGone.en: Waiting for {name}, who is no longer in the company: send it to someone else.

approvals.line.approved.en: Everyone in the chain approved this version.

approvals.line.approvedChanged.en: This version was approved, but the file has changed since: the approval does not apply to it any more.

approvals.line.outdated.en: The file changed after it was sent, so this round no longer counts.

approvals.line.superseded.en: A newer version went to other people after the round you were asked about.

approvals.withdrawConfirm.en: Withdraw this version from approval? Whoever it waits for is told nothing is needed from them.

approvals.actionFailed.en: That did not work. Try again in a minute.

approvals.sendFailed.en: Not sent. Try again in a minute.

approvals.decide.rule.en: You approve this version only. If you return it, say what to change: the author works from your comment, and the new version starts the chain over.

approvals.decide.commentPlaceholder.en: What to change, or a word to go with your approval

approvals.decide.commentNeeded.en: Write what to change before returning it.

approvals.author.nextStep.en: Change the file, then send the new version: the chain starts over.

approvals.version.noText.en: This kind of file is not shown here: open or download it.

approvals.file.none.en: This file is not on approval. Choose who approves it, in order, and send the version it holds now.

approvals.file.missing.en: The file is not there any more.

approvals.file.tooLarge.en: A file sent for approval can be at most {maxMb} MB.

approvals.file.activeRule.en: Any change to the file now voids this round: the new version would start the chain over.

approvals.file.approvedRule.en: Any change to the file voids this approval.

approvals.file.unchangedSinceSent.en: The file has not changed since this version was sent.

approvals.file.sendSame.en: Send it again as it is

approvals.notice.onApproval.en: This file is on approval: saving a change voids the round, and the chain starts over.

approvals.notice.approved.en: This version is approved: saving a change voids the approval.

approvals.form.chainEmpty.en: Nobody yet: add the people below in the order they should decide.

approvals.form.nobody.en: There is nobody else in the company to ask.

approvals.form.howItWorks.en: They get the version the file holds now, one after another: the next person is asked once the one before approves. Any change to the file afterwards voids their approvals.

approvals.error.outside.en: This file is not in this workspace's projects folder.

approvals.error.missing.en: The file is not there any more.

approvals.error.notFile.en: Only a plain file can be sent for approval.

approvals.error.sensitive.en: This file holds credentials and is never sent.

approvals.error.tooLarge.en: A file sent for approval can be at most {maxMb} MB.

approvals.error.empty.en: The file is empty: there is nothing to approve.

shares.description.en: Files your colleagues shared with you, and the ones you shared. A shared file stays in its owner's workspace: everyone it is shared with sees it as it is now, comments on it, and - if they may edit - changes it there.

shares.unavailable.en: Sharing is not available in this workspace.

shares.loadFailed.en: Could not load the shared files.

shares.actionFailed.en: That did not work. Try again in a minute.

shares.empty.withMe.en: Nobody has shared a file with you yet.

shares.empty.mine.en: You have not shared anything yet. Open a file and choose Share.

shares.may.comment.en: You can look at it and comment on it.

shares.may.edit.en: You can look at it, comment on it and change it. Each change is kept in its owner's history under your name.

shares.notice.shared.en: Shared with {names}: they see each change once it is saved.

shares.file.none.en: Not shared yet. Add the people below and choose what each may do.

shares.file.nobodyNow.en: Nobody has it now. Add people, or stop sharing.

shares.file.nobodyElse.en: There is nobody else in the company to share with.

shares.file.howItWorks.en: They see the file as it is in your workspace, with every change you save. View lets them look, Comment lets them leave comments, Edit lets them change it too - each change goes into the file's history under their name.

shares.file.stopConfirm.en: Stop sharing this file? Everyone loses it, and its comments are deleted.

shares.error.badPerson.en: Each person needs a role: view, comment or edit.

shares.error.outside.en: This file is not in this workspace's projects folder.

shares.error.missing.en: The file is not there any more.

shares.error.notFile.en: Only a plain file can be shared.

shares.error.sensitive.en: This file holds credentials and is never shared.

shares.error.tooLarge.en: A shared file can be at most {maxMb} MB.

shares.comments.pickHint.en: To comment on one piece, pick it on the page or select lines in the code.

shares.comments.deleteThreadConfirm.en: Delete this comment and its replies?

shares.view.gone.en: The file is not in its owner's workspace any more.

shares.view.noPreview.en: This kind of file is not shown here.

shares.view.extracted.en: The words of the document, read out of it: download it to see it as it is.

shares.view.selectHelp.en: Point at a block of the page to comment on it

shares.view.selectHelpEdit.en: Point at a block to comment on it, or double-click to change its words

shares.view.selectHint.en: Click a block to comment on it.

shares.view.notSaved.en: Not saved. Try again in a minute.

shares.view.changedSince.en: Not saved: the file changed since you opened it. Load the new version and make your change there.

shares.view.reloadConfirm.en: Load the new version? What you typed here is replaced.
